# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: redis
description: A Helm chart for deploying a Redis stateful cache.
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "7.0"

---
# FILE: values.yaml
# Default values for redis.
# This is a YAML-formatted file.
# Declare variables to be passed into your templates.

replicaCount: 1

image:
  repository: redis
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  # Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart's appVersion.
  tag: "7.0-alpine"

imagePullSecrets: []
nameOverride: ""
fullnameOverride: ""

serviceAccount:
  # Specifies whether a service account should be created.
  create: true
  # Annotations to add to the service account.
  annotations: {}
  # The name of the service account to use.
  # If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template.
  name: ""

podAnnotations: {}

podSecurityContext:
  fsGroup: 999
  runAsUser: 999
  runAsNonRoot: true

securityContext:
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 999
  capabilities:
    drop:
      - ALL

service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 6379

# Headless service for the StatefulSet
headlessService:
  port: 6379

auth:
  enabled: true
  # If enabled, a secret will be created with a random password.
  # To use an existing secret, set 'existingSecret.name'
  # To specify a password, set 'password'.
  password: ""
  existingSecret:
    name: ""
    key: "redis-password"

persistence:
  enabled: true
  # If defined, storageClassName: <storageClassName>
  # If set to "-", storageClassName: "", which disables dynamic provisioning
  # If undefined (the default) or set to null, no storageClassName spec is
  #   set, choosing the default provisioner.
  storageClassName: ""
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  size: 1Gi

resources:
  # We usually recommend not to specify default resources and to leave this as a conscious
  # choice for the user. This also increases chances charts run on environments with
  # different resource availability (e.g. smaller clusters).
  # limits:
  #   cpu: 100m
  #   memory: 128Mi
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 128Mi

nodeSelector: {}

tolerations: []

affinity: {}

---
# FILE: templates/_helpers
